title: Fixed-arity R6D CPU recurrence A/B test
question: Can a fixed-arity R6D factor-message kernel reduce CPU recurrence latency without changing any BP output or correction?
acceptance: bitwise-identical marginals, convergence flags, iteration counts, and residuals for every matched row
identical posterior-LLR MWPM corrections for every matched row
report median and mean recurrence latency separately from template refresh
claim_boundary: A CPU micro-optimization A/B test only; it does not alter BP approximation, establish decoder accuracy, or imply GPU throughput.
